facts.fact: Jozenji-dori runs east–west through central Sendai.
facts.excerpt: a tree-lined avenue running east–west through the center of Sendai

facts.fact: The avenue takes its name from a temple that no longer exists.
facts.excerpt: Although Jozenji Temple no longer exists

facts.fact: Zelkova trees line both sides and the central promenade.
facts.excerpt: Zelkova trees (or Japanese elms) are planted along both sides of the avenue

facts.fact: The central promenade is about700metres with benches, flowerbeds and sculptures.
facts.excerpt: The central promenade is about 700 meters long and furnished with benches, flowerbeds, and sculptures.

facts.fact: Its green appearance varies by season; a photograph is not a guarantee of foliage or illumination.
facts.excerpt: The trees create a lush, green canopy during spring and summer.
